text: {"reply":"I'm glad you're on the shoulder. Stay in the car with your hazards on and your seatbelt buckled. If you can't stay safe there, call 911. I don't have a tow arrival time, so I'm passing you to a person now to confirm the tow and the time. I've also noted that you want the service manager to call you, not an advisor, about the soft brakes after RO-168471. They have your number, (905) 555-0179. Can you tell me which direction you're heading on the 401, or the nearest exit?","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"Customer is stranded on the narrow shoulder of the 401 on-ramp in Burlington. Their 2023 Meridian Lumen EV (plate CNUE 781) died after the brakes went soft. Phone: (905) 555-0179. They need a tow dispatched and an arrival time confirmed. They also want a formal complaint on record about RO-168471, where they say Gregory told them on Friday the car was safe to drive after a brake job. They want a call from the service manager today, not an advisor. A colleague earlier said the tow was dispatched and the manager would call. Neither is confirmed by a tool.","policy_rules_cited":["P-08","P-03","P-04"]}
